item.coloph: 'di ni ud dpal me tog bzhin/ brgya'i nang na yang re re tsam/ las ldan min pa chig rgyud (brgyud) bya/ kun gyis shes na gang gi mkhas/ drod tshad 'thon pa'i man ngag yin/ rigs lnga'i mkha' 'gro'i snying khrag yin/ sde brgyad gnad kyi srog gzer yin/ las can cig gi cha rkyen yin/ gsang rgya gdab cing gcig brgyud bya/ gsang nas spyod na dngos grub myur/ man ngag rin chen 'phreng ba rdzogs so// sa ma ya/ rgya rgya rgya/ mang+ga lam//
